Real Betis vs Real Madrid La Liga match to be streamed live in India

Real Betis will face Real Madrid in a La Liga fixture of the 2026-27 season. The match is scheduled to be broadcast live to Indian audiences through online streaming services. Outlook India, a centrist outlet, published a preview that listed the platforms and timing for Indian viewers. Republic World, a right‑leaning outlet, also released a guide on when and where the game can be watched in India. Both outlets indicate that the streaming will be accessible via the same digital providers mentioned in their guides.
